independent_unit: Original image plus parent scene/asset family; seeds/prompts/frames/steps/layers nested
exposure: All R17 selected metadata and C1/C2 inspected labels are discovery-exposed; final method selection uses separate scene groups

development_slots.selection: Seeded sampling within strata before outcomes, exact hash and parent scene disjointness, near-duplicate review; no actual image manifest selected here

coverage_pilot.allocation: Rotate one band per step per source; three sources and two seeds per step-band cell; randomize actual source-to-slot and block-to-stratum mapping before outcomes
coverage_pilot.claim: Coverage budget, not power or precision guarantee

latent_and_space.spatial_units: Probability-sampled complete native tiles; store inclusion probabilities and deployment geometry; weighted aggregation
latent_and_space.oracle_scope: Top84 of sampled336 is only a sample oracle, not full31668 deployment bound

camera_optional_diagnostic.official_protocol: Separate from unchanged official I2V metadata

final_quality.reason: Determine from independent pilot source-paired variance, prespecified effect and precision; no current power claim
final_quality.finite_sample: t iteration or source-cluster simulation with pilot variance uncertainty and multiplicity
final_quality.seeds: Random and recorded, paired across methods; no cherry-picking
final_quality.population_weights: Prespecified usage weights and per-stratum summaries; report balanced macro separately

runtime.cost: Both GEMMs, QDQ, compensation, routing, norms, compaction, restore, and complete video wall
runtime.inference: Source-level paired times; technical repeats do not increase independent N

order: Complete paired source blocks, round-robin strata, counterbalanced arm order; report missing blocks
